'''Storage crystals''' were data storage mediums. [[Recording rod]]s used storage crystals to store audio and video recordings.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] collected several storage crystals full of information on former-[[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] exploits in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="HSCSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
